data.name: Weather Lord: Legendary Hero Collector's Edition
data.detailed_description:
REMEDIUM: SENTINELS - OUT NOW!


SCHOLAR OF THE ARCANE ARTS - OUT NOW IN EARLY ACCESS


Acerca do jogo

Call upon the gods of Olympus to help you rescue your beloved before all hope is gone! Everything seems to be going well when the Weather Lord and his wife, Olivia, leave their homeland to enjoy some R&R, but when they arrive at their island destination, the place is in ruins. Then, without warning. Olivia is sucked through a portal and the gateway closes, seemingly taking the queen away from her king forever. A hero, however, will always find a way to make things right.

To save Olivia, you must wield the power of the sun, the wind, the rain, and more as you face towering obstacles, encounter strange enemies, and repair a ravaged land. Manage your resources well, and victory will be yours. With each thrilling step you take, you'll gain powerful new bonuses and then encounter fresh challenges that require you to use them in clever ways. You'll also rebuild villages, engage in trade, and interact with fabled Greek gods.

This Collector's Edition of Weather Lord: Legendary Herocontains a king's ransom in extras! From a huge bonus chapter to a step-by-step walkthrough of the game, and from downloadable wallpapers and music to character bios and an exclusive mini-game, there's no shortage of fun to be had! Unfolding with the scope of an epic fantasy adventure, Weather Lord: Legendary Hero – Collector's Edition will capture your imagination even as it draws you into hours of compelling gameplay!

  • Dozens of challenging levels!
  • Vibrant graphics and animation!
  • A thrilling story of romance and adventure!
  • Awards and achievements galore!
  • Tons of AWESOME extras!

reviews.review:
[h1]Weather Lord: Legendary Hero Collectors Edition [/h1]

[i]Weather Lord legendary hero is the 3rd installment to the weather lord game collection. The game is a resource, time management, strategy style game similar to the others and its a very enjoyable game to play, if you have plenty patients, and enjoy these type games.[/i]
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=739870371
[i]Princess Olivia and Prince Victor are now happily married and have moved to an island paradise to start a new life and home. When they arrive they discover how messy the island and beach's are, and so set out to clean them all up. BUT sadly Princess Olivia was pulled into a secret portal that appeared. Now Prince Victor has set out on his journey to not only clean up the Island and restore all the shrines, but to also find his true love and princess.[/i]

[i]When you start the game, you get a choice whether to play on "Normal" (timed mode) OR "Relaxed" (no time limits mode), I just play on Relaxed as I don't like to be rushed and this mode for me is more relaxing anyway, but the choice is yours.[/i]

[i]There are more than 70+ levels, split between 2 maps as 1 is the Special Edition map levels, and all very nice levels and fun to play. You also can find Artifacts and Puzzle piece's through out the levels, so look out for the puzzle pieces hiding with in some levels, collect to make a nice surprise picture.[/i]
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=739868550
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=739868902
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=739869744
[i] Also I want to point out that the helpers are now very cute and adorable little Bears, yes that's right they are Bears ;D.[/i]
 
[i] I have not had the game for long, but so far what I have played I have really enjoyed, as I did with the other 2. There are also in game achievements, BUT  " NO STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS "for this game :(, & when a game has achievements, I feel more inclined to continue to play it, as I did with " Weather Lord: Following the Princess" and I finished it with all 100% achievements. [/i]

[i] Trading Cards are available BUT sorry no Steam Achievements. I hope the developer will reconsider and add this feature, as so many of us love steam achievements greatly. [/i] 

 [i] Even though I was given this game by the publisher for free, I would have most certainly bought it eitherway, as I really enjoy playing these games, when given time to do so. BUT I do prefer them to have Steam achievements.[/i]
